title: How do I use AI to speed up character and asset creation for my game, and what is the best route?
author: ExcitingSleep
selftext:
Hello all,  
I am a hobby Blender user of many years. I love it, but it is time-consuming.  
In my free time, I am developing a game, which is also time-consuming.  
I like to create low-poly, Half-Life-style character models and assets for my game using LLMs like Codex.  
My question is not how to use it, but did anyone use it and have good results?  
I would love to hear about it,  
thanks

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: I Only get good results in Code, never on Art. Probably another year until its specific enough

replies.author: ExcitingSleep
replies.body: YouTube is full of demos showing people using Blender MCP with AI. I guess it is just the usual clickbait, as always.

replies.author: UnfortunateHurricane
replies.body:
I think it kinda depends on your expectations. 

Can you show me what you want to achieve? I had some first tests with Opus 5 and some MCP. I have no experience in blender and for me it looked decent enough but it had way to many polys. One would probably need to guide the model through towards an acceptable number (again no idea how many that would be)

comments.author: standardofiron
comments.body: I created a custom mcp for blender, had great results with it. For smaller assets you can even connect it to free models like deepseek v4 flash and still have surprisingly good assets

replies.author: TriggerHydrant
replies.body:
So if I get this: you can hookup deepseek v4 as an MCP into Codex or Claude, have it generate a (small) asset and get it back directly into the game? How would you go about applying texture or does it do that too?

Thank you

replies.author: standardofiron
replies.body:
Yep, that’s basically the workflow. I use OpenCode with DeepSeek V4 because it’s free there and doesn’t even require registration. I have a few videos about it on my channel.

For more complex work, I connect the Blender MCP to Claude or Codex. I usually work like this:

I ask the model to create something from scratch, or point it to another asset on disk to use as a reference. Then I inspect the result visually, give feedback, and iterate until I’m happy with it. Once it looks good, I save/export the asset somewhere.

From there, you can import it into your game manually, or ask the model you use for coding to pick it up from that location and integrate it. You can also keep everything in one large session, frontier models are generally capable of handling the asset creation and game integration together.

Materials and textures can be handled in the same iterative way: ask the model to create or apply them, inspect the result, and refine it until it looks right.

comments.author: sridden
comments.body:
Hitem3D is the best 3D generative suite/model I've found, for mechanical and hard surface work where you can just decimate to the lowest possible poly count it's pretty useful. Less so for deforming meshes, manual ratio required.

For 2D art assets nano banana is quite useful.

comments.author: JedahVoulThur
comments.body:
Since you know Blender, I think we are both in a similar situation. The current AI tools generate good models but bad topology and uv unwrapping.
My current workflow is this:  
1. Create turnaround images in a low poly style already 
2. Send them to Hunyuan, as a high density model  
3. Retopo and unwrapping manually in Blender  
4. Bake normal map from high poly to the retopo  
5. Profit  
  
Step 3 can be sped up by using a good topology uv unwrapped model you have and shrinkwrap it over the high poly one. I haven't tried it yet but saw that the latest version of Blender included a new sculpting tool that seems to be perfect for this. Another trick is to not generate the entire character in one pass, but separate the head, hands, torso and legs separately and then rejoin it in Blender. I also generate my characters wearing underwear and generate the clothes separately. Not for lewd purposes, but because it will make animation easier when I reach that point haha 
Hunyuan gives you 20 free generations free per day, more than enough to have 4 or 5 new characters everyday.
